# Step 2.128: your name, your password, your email

## Layer 1, the name (builders 1 and 2: 61af9e0d, dcd2fec7, 550cc033, bd3bf88d)

- `identify` refuses an account with no own profile as `name-needed`; pages send it to
  `/account?next=` (S-125). Commands `give-own-name.ts`, `change-own-name.ts`; browser tests
  answer through the kit's `answerNameScreen`. No name (T-447): `local-unnamed-token`.

## Layer 2, the password (builder 3; T-451, T-452, S-127)

- The interface (`packages/providers/src/sign-in/sign-in-service.ts`) gains (T-451)
  `changePassword`: old one counted as `confirmPassword`'s guesses (T-225), new one by
  `setPassword`'s rule, other sessions ended; stand-in and Supabase (`PUT /user`, `others`).
- Done (0584915a, d52a7897): command `server/sign-in/change-own-password.ts` (T-452; mails
  once via `mail.passwordChanged`), action `password-actions.ts` (refresh), form
  `features/sign-in/change-password-form.tsx`; P6 corrected; S-127 (Google-only accounts).
- Passed: sign-in units, test:web, change-password-test and the browser tests that sign in.
- Mended (770f999e): admins-invitations-test (each person answers with their own name);
  A-14's "No name yet" is proved in your-name-test.
- Distrust: Supabase's change is unverified live (a "secure password change" would ask a nonce).

## Layer 3, the email (builder 5; T-455, T-457, T-458, S-129)

- T-455: the pending change is the sign-in service's (stand-in: memory beside its codes;
  Supabase: its own pending address, our store the code's attempts); 0031 widens the store's
  codes, adds the owner-run functions that move accounts.email (T-458). Accounts made before
  have no pending change; nothing reads one that is not there.
- Interface: `startEmailChange`, `confirmEmailChange` (both adapters; Supabase: generate_link
  `email_change_new`, verify `email_change`, needs "secure email change" off, unverified live).
- Commands `server/sign-in/start-own-email-change.ts`, `confirm-own-email-change.ts` (T-457),
  action `email-actions.ts` (refresh), form `features/sign-in/change-email-form.tsx`; port
  `ownEmail` (database: 0031's functions; stand-in: always free). Notices `mail.emailChange*`.
- Passed: both adapters' units, the commands, 0031 (pglite), app-role, isolation, test:web,
  check, typecheck, change-email-test (fails with the stand-in keeping other sessions),
  change-password-test, your-name-test. Not run: harmful-text (new `/account` pin newEmail).
